watches.name: "FOXTROT"
watches.description: Be Among the First to Own the "Foxtrot" Pre-order our newest " Foxtrot" . Secure your watch now before its official release. Delivery is expected between January 31 and February 28, 2027 , with a shipping update provided in early January 2027 . Inspired by the early RAF pilot watch, the Sunrex's 2nd pilot solar chronograph, "Foxtrot" , has a "white" dial. Foxtrot's design cues and details are also drawn heavily from the RAF's iconic Spitfire . Foxtrot 's dial is an extention of Spitfire's instrument panel. The sub-dials on the watch is designed to echo the various gauages found on the aircraft's cockpit. Worn appearance of dial is a contiuation of Sunrex's style vision of seeking beauty in weathered and imperfection. The chronograph start/stop pusher is inspired by the trigger button found in the Spitfire's control column. The reset pusher features the shape of the Spitfire's iconic exhaust stacks of the Merlin and Griffin engine, special plating is added to mimic the “burnt” look. At the heart of the “Foxtrot” is the latest Ronda 2040.D Solar Chronograph movement , powered by light for convenient operation, with power reserve up to 5 months. The chronograph provides counters of 1/10th of a second, 30mins and 10 hour. In contrast with the now very common "flieger" black dial pilot watch, Sunrex offers a different kind pilot watch experience. Key Features Newest Ronda 2040.D Solar Chronograph movement Inspired by the legendary Supermarine Spitfire fighter aircraft Three cockpit-inspired sub-dials modeled after Spitfire flight instrument panel Gun-trigger-inspired chronograph start/stop pusher Dial accents are deliberately applied to achieve a worn-in, heritage-inspired look Burnt exhaust-inspired reset pusher with heat-treated coloration 1/10-second chronograph timing capability Scratch-resistant sapphire crystal Vintage pilot-watch design with authentic aviation heritage Sunrex Pilot Type “Foxtrot” combines the timeless legacy of the Spitfire with modern solar-powered performance, creating a pilot chronograph that celebrates both the aircraft and the language of aviation. Specifications Model: RX0031 Pilot Type “Foxtrot” Movement: Ronda 2040.D Solar Chronograph Power Reserve: Up to 5 months Chronograph: Chronograph function with 1/10-second timing, 30-minute and 10-hour counters Case: Stainless steel with IPH coating Crystal: Museum-grade domed sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating Straps: FKM rubber strap and Nylon strap with genuine leather backing Water Resistance: 50m (5ATM) Dial: Cream dial with aviation-inspired indicators, luminous dial and hands, date window Dimensions: 38.5mm diameter × 45.5mm lug-to-lug × 13mm thickness

watches.name: "BETA" Prague Edition
watches.description: Sunrex “BETA” Prague Edition Limited to only 30 pieces. Collaborated with Infinity Watches. Celebrates the expanding microbrand community in Prague. Created in collaboration with Infinity Watches , organizer of Micro Praha Festival , the SUNREX "Beta" Prague Edition is a special collector's edition based on the acclaimed "Beta" chronograph. Limited to only 30 individually numbered pieces worldwide, this exclusive release celebrates the growing microbrand watch community in Prague. The highlight of the Prague Edition is its distinctive running seconds display, featuring the red, white, and blue colours of the Czech national flag, a tribute to both the city and the passionate microbrand watch enthusiasts who gather annually at Micro Praha. Like the standard "Beta", the Prague Edition is powered by the proprietary Viluminus™ solar-powered chronograph movement, which converts both natural and artificial light into energy. Once fully charged, the watch can operate for up to five months without further exposure to light, combining everyday practicality with sustainable timekeeping. Inspired by 1950s pilot chronographs, the "Beta" Prague Edition maintains the model's signature black dial, gilt accents, DLC-coated rotating bezel, and vintage instrument aesthetic, while introducing an exclusive colour detail available only to this limited collaboration. Each watch is individually engraved with one of thirty dedicated serial numbers, making every piece a unique collectible for Micro Praha participants and microbrand watch enthusiasts alike. watches.name: "611" Targa Classica Edition
watches.description: Sunrex “611” Targa Classica Edition Limited to only 29 pieces. Exclusively created by Sunrex and Grip Auto Timepieces. Embodying the spirit of the Targa Classica. Crafted in collaboration with Targa Classica ( Melbourne, Australia) , this exclusive limited-edition chronograph captures the spirit of the open road. Designed for the microbrand watch enthusiasts, it blends timeless motorsport heritage with refined craftsmanship — a rare piece made to be worn, admired, and collected. Inspired by the legendary heritage race machine that claimed victory at last year’s Targa Classica, the watch draws directly from the car’s racing DNA. It also reflects the philosophy that "winning is not enough" — a belief that true success in motorsport is defined not only by speed, but by precision, judgment, craftsmanship, and respect for the machine. The dial references period gauges, the chronograph layout echoes classic pit-lane timing, and carefully selected materials reflect the precision and elegance of early competition machines. To further enhance its character, the "611" Targa Classica is crafted with a deliberate retro aesthetic. Subtle variations in the blue bezel—most notably a gentle fading at the upper right and lower left—are intentionally incorporated to evoke a vintage, worn-in look. This distinctive finish is applied during production, ensuring each piece carries the same heritage-inspired appeal. Every watch tells a story of endurance, speed, and the people behind the wheel — not just a moment in history, but a legacy carried on the wrist. Highlights Solar-Powered Precision: Equipped with a high-quality solar-powered chronograph movement, delivering reliability and sustainability without compromise. Design Heritage: Bezel fading is deliberately applied to achieve a worn-in, heritage-inspired look. Bespoke Finishing: Unique engravings and edition-specific elements exclusive to this collaboration. Collector’s Rarity: Only 29 pieces worldwide, each individually numbered . Specifications Movement : Epson VS76A light-powered quartz, holds up to 5 months of charge Chronograph : 1/20 second center chronograph, 60-minute stopwatch Case & Bezel: Stainless steel case with IPH coating Crystal : Museum-grade domed sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating Straps : FKM rubber strap and environmentally tanned leather strap Water Resistance : 100m Dial : Silver dial with perlage finishing, luminescent hands and markers, date window Crown : Screw-down crown at 3 o’clock Dimensions : 37mm diameter, 44mm lug-to-lug, 14mm thickness Serial Numbers : 219, 220, 221, 225, 226, 227, 231, 232, 234, 235, 236, 237, 238, 239, 240, 241, 242, 243, 244, 245, 246, 247, 248, 249, 250, 253, 254, 255, 256 Let us tell you all about The "611" Targa Classica Edition Racing has always been about more than speed. The drivers who shaped the sport knew that precision, judgment, and safety mattered just as much as raw performance. The "611" Targa Classica Edition takes inspiration from that philosophy. Its clear dial layout and high-contrast accents echo the readability of early racing timers, while its solar-powered movement adds reliability you can count on every day. Designed for microbrand watch and motorsport enthusiasts who appreciate purposeful design and a watch that keeps up with a fast-moving life, the "611" Targa Classica Edition blends motorsport influence with modern practicality. It’s a reminder that control, craftsmanship, and awareness are the real tools of great drivers.

watches.name: "321" (Artneun Edition)
watches.description: Limited to 15 pieces worldwide [Racer’s Type Collection] Created in collaboration with ArtNeun ( Melbourne, Austraila) , the 321 ArtNeun Edition celebrates the design language and legacy of the iconic rear-engine sports cars that defined a generation. Its Viper Green CERAKOTE-coated case takes inspiration from one of the rarest colorways ever produced, a shade found on only 69 cars and remembered for its bold personality and unmistakable presence. Lightweight, durable, and built with precision timing in mind, this limited release blends automotive heritage with the clean, functional design Sunrex is known for. To underscore its exclusivity, only 15 pieces have been produced worldwide, making it exceptionally rare and highly collectible. Each one is individually numbered and crafted to be as collectible as it is wearable. Highlights Limited edition of 15 pieces CERAKOTE-coated aluminum case inspired by Viper Green Solar-powered Viluminus movement 1/20 second chronograph Domed sapphire crystal Includes FKM rubber and leather straps Specifications Movement : Epson VS76A light-powered quartz, holds up to 5 months of charge Chronograph : 1/20 second center chronograph, 60-minute stopwatch Case & Coating : Aluminum case with CERAKOTE ceramic coating for high scratch resistance, abrasion protection, and long-lasting color Crystal : Museum-grade domed sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating Straps : FKM rubber strap and environmentally tanned leather strap Water Resistance : 100m Dial : Black dial with luminescent hands and markers, date window Crown : Screw-down crown at 3 o’clock Dimensions : 38.6mm diameter, 43.5mm lug-to-lug, 14mm thickness Serial Numbers : 119, 120, 121, 123, 124, 125, 126, 128, 129, 133, 135, 136, 137, 138, 140 Let us tell you all about The 321 ArtNeun Edition This edition draws on the spirit of the rear-engine sports cars that paired engineering precision with unmistakable character. Known for their agility and distinctive silhouette, these cars also carried a philosophy rooted in discipline, innovation, and performance. The ArtNeun collaboration captures that energy through a case coated in CERAKOTE, a high-performance ceramic-polymer composite chosen for its superior durability, corrosion resistance, and UV stability. It keeps the color vibrant and the watch protected through everyday wear. Designed for microbrand watch collectors who appreciate thoughtful craftsmanship and meaningful details, the 321 ArtNeun Edition blends motorsport heritage, wearable engineering, and Sunrex’s modern solar technology. With only 15 made, it’s a rare opportunity to own a piece that reflects both brands’ shared commitment to craft and purpose.

watches.name: "BANANA REEF"
watches.description: [Diver’s Type Collection] The Banana Reef is, as a microbrand watch maker, our tribute to the golden age of underwater exploration. It honors the clever watchmakers and the timeless cushion case of the 1930s. The black dial is a nod to the depths of the ocean. The corrosion-resistant case, an example of the rugged construction that defined that era. If you're after a cushion case dive watch that combines the iconic style of the 1930s and is still practical for everyday use, this is the one for you. Highlights Solar powered Viluminus movement 1930s-inspired cushion case diver watch Black DLC-coated cushion case and domed crystal Water resistant to 100m Includes both leather and Tyvek straps Specifications Movement : Epson VS75A light-powered quartz, holds up to 5 months of charge Chronograph : 1/5 second center chronograph, 60-minute stopwatch Case & Bezel : Stainless steel case with black DLC-coated bezel Crystal : Museum-grade domed crystal with anti-reflective coating Straps : Vegetable-tanned leather strap and Tyvek strap, 20mm Water Resistance : 100m Dial : Black dial with gold accents, luminescent hands and markers, date window Crown : Screw-down crown at 3 o’clock Dimensions : 40mm diameter, 47mm lug-to-lug, 13.5mm thickness Let us tell you all about The Banana Reef In the 1930s, diving watches were still evolving from experimental gear into dependable tools. Early underwater explorers relied on rugged cases, rotating bezels, and highly legible dials to keep track of their time below the surface. Those innovations inspired the Banana Reef. It carries the charm of those early tool watches while adding the reliability of modern solar technology and everyday durability. Whether you’re heading into the water or just making your way through the day, the Banana Reef delivers that classic diver look with the practicality to match.

watches.name: "BETA"
watches.description: [Pilot’s Type Collection] The Beta channels the spirit of mid-century aviation, when pilot’s watches were built for precision, quick reads, and mechanical reliability. Its black dial takes cues from old cockpit instruments, while the chronograph layout mirrors the timing tools pilots depended on in the air. What started as a naming mix-up became part of its character, giving the Beta a story as distinctive as its look. Rugged, refined, and ready for everyday wear, it captures the cool, functional style of 1950s pilot chronographs. Highlights Solar-powered Viluminus movement 1950s-inspired pilot chronograph Black dial with gold accents Black DLC-coated rotating bezel Leather and Tyvek straps included Specifications Movement : Epson VS75A light-powered quartz, holds up to 5 months of charge Chronograph : 1/5 second center chronograph, 60-minute stopwatch Case & Bezel : Stainless steel case with black DLC-coated rotating bezel Crystal : Domed crystal with museum-grade anti-reflective coating Straps : Vegetable-tanned leather strap and Tyvek strap, 20mm Water Resistance : 100m Dial : Black dial with gold accents, luminescent hands and markers, date window Crown : Screw-down crown at 3 o’clock Dimensions : 41mm diameter, 48mm lug-to-lug, 14mm thickness Let us tell you all about The Beta Pilot watches in the 1950s were designed as essential flight tools. Large, legible dials. Reliable movements. Bold hands that stayed visible in low-light cockpits. Rotating bezels that helped track fuel or timing at a glance. The Beta draws from those practical details, pairing them with modern solar technology and durable construction. Its name comes from a happy mistake. What was meant to be “Bravo” became “Beta,” and instead of revising course, we embraced the detour. It’s a small reminder that great design sometimes comes from unexpected turns. The result is a pilot’s chronograph that feels grounded in history but built for now.

watches.name: "ANEMONE CITY"
watches.description: [Driver’s Type Collection] Anemone City draws from the bold dive chronographs of the 1950s and the deep blues of one of the Maldives’ iconic underwater sites. Its gradient dial mirrors the shift from sunlight to open water, while the chronograph layout nods to the essential timing tools early divers relied on. With a polished stainless steel case built to handle the everyday and the occasional adventure, this microbrand watch blends classic diver charm with clean modern practicality. Rotating bezels, luminous hands, and robust cases became essential tools for divers navigating uncharted waters. Anemone City carries forward those defining features with a modern microbrand watchmaker's touch. It’s built for durability, designed for everyday wear, and shaped by an era that changed dive watches forever.
